roundingBoundaryCases.explanation: Whole-minute USNO midnight value rounds from preceding exact civil day; Helio correctly excludes it from selected day.

provenance.provenance: USNO oneday (tz=0/UTC). sundata/moondata phen times "HH:MM"; civil twilight only.
provenance.note: USNO-derived published data; current official API request failed ECONNRESET. These expected values were not calculated from Helio or SunCalc.

checks.name: 25-hour DST day uses elapsed range and both 01:30 instants
Actual JSON and ICS downloads retain selected absolute time and zone
Every available event button jumps to its exact calculated instant
Explicit save, restore and delete work without implicit writes
Invalid zone leaves the current plan and gives feedback
Manual coordinates reject out-of-range input, then stay local
Polar night events and jumps retain twilight
Now and previous/next day update date and keep the range bounded
3D compass headings, follow mode, 2D fallback and language toggle respond
Normal runtime and custom coordinates make no third-party requests
Malformed saved JSON produces feedback and remains removable
Malformed URL recovers and DST gap URL reports feedback
Storage denied keeps planner usable and provides feedback
No JavaScript page errors during executed flows

scope: Local current-source Chromium QA only. No public/live deployment audited by this reviewer; no scientific pixel-angle calibration or weather/terrain prediction.
